result.title: GroundedVDR: Grounding Video-to-Web Evidence Dependencies in Video Deep Research
result.summary: Video large multimodal models have improved at identifying cross-frame visual evidence and conducting open-web retrieval, as reflected in recent video deep research (VDR) benchmarks. However, existing VDR benchmarks primarily evaluate tool-use trajectories and final responses without verifying whether a model actually uses the temporal video information or the retrieved web evidence. To fill this gap, we introduce \method{}, an evidence-grounded benchmark with three features. First, it combines human review with restricted-access probing across multiple models to exclude questions answerable from parametric knowledge or a single information source. Second, each question carries structured video-to-web evidence annotations that link the relevant video segments to their supporting web evidence. Third, its evaluation protocol separately scores video grounding, web evidence grounding, and final-answer correctness. Across eight multimodal agent systems, the best reaches 76.0\% answer accuracy, yet none recovers the complete required web evidence for more than 8\% of questions. Our benchmark is publicly available at \url{https://huggingface.co/datasets/hh721/vdr_temp}.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 GroundedVDR，一个视频深度研究基准：通过人工审核与受限访问探测排除可凭参数知识或单一来源作答的问题，为每题标注视频片段到网页证据的结构化依赖，并将视频定位、网页证据定位与最终答案正确性分开评分，评测了八个多模态智能体。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心正是检验模型是否真正使用了时序视觉信息与检索证据而非参数知识，与 LVR 关注的视觉旁路、证据筛选和贡献分配问题直接相关，其「无系统能恢复完整网页证据」的观察可供核查模型对内部状态的依赖程度。
